Author: BlueWaveXIV
Name: AutoBuy
Description: Private Market Board helper that searches configured gear keywords and buys listings at or below a configurable gil cap.
Punchline: Buy underpriced gear sets from the Market Board.
Changelog: Added datacentre and world dropdowns to the travel overlay. Added a Travel button so AutoBuy can request Lifestream travel to a selected world before buying there. Kept the quick Back to Ravana button for returning home.
